themes.title: Ownership
themes.question: What does it mean to own?
themes.description: We create, exchange and place value on things every day. But who decides what belongs to us, what it is worth, and who gets to benefit? Where does access end and ownership begin?

themes.title: Permanence
themes.question: What happens when things don't last?
themes.description: Objects, memories, platforms and ideas all change or disappear. What do we lose when they don't last? What should be preserved, repaired or passed on, and what are we willing to let go?

themes.title: Energy
themes.question: What powers possibility?
themes.description: Energy moves through the systems we depend on, from natural resources and infrastructure to human effort and creative drive. Who has access to it? How is it distributed, and what does it make possible?

themes.title: Peers
themes.question: How do we connect on our own terms?
themes.description: Connection depends on more than being online. How do trust, privacy and shared purpose shape the ways we communicate, organise and support one another? What can people build together when they have control?
